    struct gradient_vs_mainOutput {
        metal::float4 position [[position]];
        metal::float2 raw_position [[user(loc0), center_perspective]];
        metal::uint4 colors_1_ [[user(loc1), flat]];
        metal::uint4 colors_2_ [[user(loc2), flat]];
        metal::uint4 colors_3_ [[user(loc3), flat]];

    struct vb_15_type { metal::uchar data[104]; };
    vertex gradient_vs_mainOutput gradient_vs_main(
      constant Globals& globals [[buffer(0)]]
    , uint v_id [[vertex_id]]
    , const device vb_15_type* vb_15_in [[buffer(15)]]
    , constant _mslBufferSizes& _buffer_sizes [[buffer(1)]]
    ) {
        metal::float2 v_pos = {};
        metal::uint4 colors_1_ = {};
        metal::uint4 colors_2_ = {};
        metal::uint4 colors_3_ = {};
        metal::uint4 colors_4_ = {};
        metal::uint4 offsets = {};
        metal::float4 direction = {};
        if (v_id < (_buffer_sizes.buffer_size15 / 104)) {
            const vb_15_type vb_15_elem = vb_15_in[v_id];
            v_pos = unpackFloat32x2_(vb_15_elem.data[0], vb_15_elem.data[1], vb_15_elem.data[2], vb_15_elem.data[3], vb_15_elem.data[4], vb_15_elem.data[5], vb_15_elem.data[6], vb_15_elem.data[7]);
            colors_1_ = unpackUint32x4_(vb_15_elem.data[8], vb_15_elem.data[9], vb_15_elem.data[10], vb_15_elem.data[11], vb_15_elem.data[12], vb_15_elem.data[13], vb_15_elem.data[14], vb_15_elem.data[15], vb_15_elem.data[16], vb_15_elem.data[17], vb_15_elem.data[18], vb_15_elem.data[19], vb_15_elem.data[20], vb_15_elem.data[21], vb_15_elem.data[22], vb_15_elem.data[23]);
            colors_2_ = unpackUint32x4_(vb_15_elem.data[24], vb_15_elem.data[25], vb_15_elem.data[26], vb_15_elem.data[27], vb_15_elem.data[28], vb_15_elem.data[29], vb_15_elem.data[30], vb_15_elem.data[31], vb_15_elem.data[32], vb_15_elem.data[33], vb_15_elem.data[34], vb_15_elem.data[35], vb_15_elem.data[36], vb_15_elem.data[37], vb_15_elem.data[38], vb_15_elem.data[39]);
            colors_3_ = unpackUint32x4_(vb_15_elem.data[40], vb_15_elem.data[41], vb_15_elem.data[42], vb_15_elem.data[43], vb_15_elem.data[44], vb_15_elem.data[45], vb_15_elem.data[46], vb_15_elem.data[47], vb_15_elem.data[48], vb_15_elem.data[49], vb_15_elem.data[50], vb_15_elem.data[51], vb_15_elem.data[52], vb_15_elem.data[53], vb_15_elem.data[54], vb_15_elem.data[55]);
            colors_4_ = unpackUint32x4_(vb_15_elem.data[56], vb_15_elem.data[57], vb_15_elem.data[58], vb_15_elem.data[59], vb_15_elem.data[60], vb_15_elem.data[61], vb_15_elem.data[62], vb_15_elem.data[63], vb_15_elem.data[64], vb_15_elem.data[65], vb_15_elem.data[66], vb_15_elem.data[67], vb_15_elem.data[68], vb_15_elem.data[69], vb_15_elem.data[70], vb_15_elem.data[71]);
            offsets = unpackUint32x4_(vb_15_elem.data[72], vb_15_elem.data[73], vb_15_elem.data[74], vb_15_elem.data[75], vb_15_elem.data[76], vb_15_elem.data[77], vb_15_elem.data[78], vb_15_elem.data[79], vb_15_elem.data[80], vb_15_elem.data[81], vb_15_elem.data[82], vb_15_elem.data[83], vb_15_elem.data[84], vb_15_elem.data[85], vb_15_elem.data[86], vb_15_elem.data[87]);
            direction = unpackFloat32x4_(vb_15_elem.data[88], vb_15_elem.data[89], vb_15_elem.data[90], vb_15_elem.data[91], vb_15_elem.data[92], vb_15_elem.data[93], vb_15_elem.data[94], vb_15_elem.data[95], vb_15_elem.data[96], vb_15_elem.data[97], vb_15_elem.data[98], vb_15_elem.data[99], vb_15_elem.data[100], vb_15_elem.data[101], vb_15_elem.data[102], vb_15_elem.data[103]);
        }
        const GradientVertexInput input = { v_pos, {}, colors_1_, colors_2_, colors_3_, colors_4_, offsets, direction };
        GradientVertexOutput output = {};
        metal::float4x4 _e5 = globals.transform;
        output.position = _e5 * metal::float4(input.v_pos, 0.0, 1.0);
        output.raw_position = input.v_pos;
        output.colors_1_ = input.colors_1_;
        output.colors_2_ = input.colors_2_;
        output.colors_3_ = input.colors_3_;
        output.colors_4_ = input.colors_4_;
        output.offsets = input.offsets;
        output.direction = input.direction;
        GradientVertexOutput _e25 = output;
        const auto _tmp = _e25;
        return gradient_vs_mainOutput { _tmp.position, _tmp.raw_position, _tmp.colors_1_, _tmp.colors_2_, _tmp.colors_3_, _tmp.colors_4_, _tmp.offsets, _tmp.direction };

        metal::float2 uv_center = input.atlas_pos + (input.atlas_scale / metal::float2(2.0));
        metal::float2 d = uv - uv_center;
        out.uv = metal::float2((d.x * cos_r) - (d.y * sin_r), (d.x * sin_r) + (d.y * cos_r)) + uv_center;
        metal::float4x4 _e144 = globals.transform;
        metal::float4 _e146 = out.position;
        out.position = _e144 * _e146;
        out.border_radius = metal::min(input.border_radius, metal::float4(metal::min(input.clip_bounds.z, input.clip_bounds.w) / 2.0));
        out.atlas = metal::float4(input.atlas_pos, input.atlas_pos + input.atlas_scale);
        out.layer = input.layer;
        out.opacity = input.opacity;
        VertexOutput _e169 = out;
        const auto _tmp = _e169;
        return vs_mainOutput { _tmp.position, _tmp.clip_bounds, _tmp.border_radius, _tmp.atlas, _tmp.layer, _tmp.opacity, _tmp.uv };
    }

    // language: metal3.2
    #include <metal_stdlib>
    #include <simd/simd.h>
    
    using metal::uint;
    
    struct VertexOutput {
        metal::float4 position;
        metal::float4 clip_bounds;
        metal::float4 border_radius;
        metal::float4 atlas;
        int layer;
        float opacity;
        metal::float2 uv;
    };
    
    metal::float4 premultiply(
        metal::float4 color
    ) {
        return metal::float4(color.xyz * color.w, color.w);
    }
    
    float rounded_box_sdf(
        metal::float2 p,
        metal::float2 size,
        metal::float4 corners
    ) {
        metal::float2 box_half = (p.x > 0.0) ? corners.xw : corners.yz;
        float corner = (p.y > 0.0) ? box_half.x : box_half.y;
        metal::float2 q = (metal::abs(p) - size) + metal::float2(corner);
        return (metal::min(metal::max(q.x, q.y), 0.0) + metal::length(metal::max(q, metal::float2(0.0)))) - corner;
    }
    
    struct fs_mainInput {
        metal::float4 clip_bounds [[user(loc0), flat]];
        metal::float4 border_radius [[user(loc1), flat]];
        metal::float4 atlas [[user(loc2), flat]];
        int layer [[user(loc3), flat]];
        float opacity [[user(loc4), flat]];
        metal::float2 uv [[user(loc5), center_perspective]];
    };
    struct fs_mainOutput {
        metal::float4 member [[color(0)]];
    };
    fragment fs_mainOutput fs_main(
      fs_mainInput varyings [[stage_in]]
    , metal::float4 position [[position]]
    , metal::sampler u_sampler [[sampler(0)]]
    , metal::texture2d_array<float, metal::access::sample> u_texture [[texture(0)]]
    ) {
        const VertexOutput input = { position, varyings.clip_bounds, varyings.border_radius, varyings.atlas, varyings.layer, varyings.opacity, varyings.uv };
        bool local = {};
        metal::float2 fragment_ = input.position.xy;
        metal::float2 position_1 = input.clip_bounds.xy;
        metal::float2 scale = input.clip_bounds.zw;
        float _e17 = rounded_box_sdf(2.0 * ((fragment_ - position_1) - (scale / metal::float2(2.0))), scale, input.border_radius * 2.0);
        float d = _e17 / 2.0;
        float antialias = metal::clamp(1.0 - d, 0.0, 1.0);
        if (metal::all(input.uv >= input.atlas.xy)) {
            local = metal::all(input.uv <= input.atlas.zw);
        } else {
            local = false;
        }
        bool inside = local;
        metal::float4 _e43 = u_texture.sample(u_sampler, input.uv, input.layer);
        metal::float4 sample = _e43 * metal::float4(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, (antialias * input.opacity) * static_cast<float>(inside));
        metal::float4 _e53 = premultiply(sample);
        return fs_mainOutput { _e53 };
    }
